rows.jyutping: A V dou3 naan4 ji5 soeng2 zoeng6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that an adjective or action reaches an unimaginable degree.

example.english: It is unimaginably hot today; I was soaked in sweat after being outside for a short while.
example.traditional: 今日熱到難以想像，出街一陣已經成身汗。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jit6 dou3 naan4 ji5 soeng2 zoeng6 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 zan6 ji5 ging1 sing4 san1 hon6
